# P32.15 — Coordinate investigation views and bounded static navigation

**Requirement ids:** SIG-FIND-004, SIG-FIND-005 (§55.5) ·
**ADR:** ADR-134 ·
**Base:** `devin/p32-14-full-corpus-release-search` (stacked on PR #170 — merge this after #170) ·
**Run:** `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/175_P32.15__coordinated-investigation-workspace.md live_verification=false` ·
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/175_P32.15__coordinated-investigation-workspace.md` (manifest row 175)

## What this does

The three opted-in investigation islands — List (`/search/`), Map (`/map/`),
Connections (`/network/`) — and their no-JS equivalents now share **one
versioned URL-state contract** (`sig.workspace-state/1`), so a query, a
licence-compartment selection, a release pin and a selected record survive
view switches, deep links, reloads and Back/Forward — **offline tooling
only**: nothing is deployed or exposed; publication stays with GATE-G3
(`D-R10-PUBLISH-1` OPEN). This is progressive enhancement, not a SPA: the
URL and the static tables remain the source of truth.

### `sig.workspace-state/1` (`web/src/lib/workspace-state.ts`, `web/src/islands/workspace.ts`)

- Canonical params in emitted order: `v`, `release`, repeated `collection`,
  `q`, repeated `kind`/`jurisdiction`/`technology`/`source`, `location`
  (the P32.14 index vocabulary verbatim), `focus`, `view`, `page`. `v` and
  `view` are always emitted; every other field drops at its default.
- **Tolerant-with-receipts parse** — an unsupported `v`, unknown `view`,
  unknown `location` or unusable `page` falls back AND reports a visible
  `issues` note (`data-testid="workspace-issues"`); unknown extra params
  are ignored (other surfaces own their query strings).
- **`focus` carries the self-describing `sig.published-record/1`
  record_key** (`<compartment>:<type>:<id>`) — `recordRoutes` derives
  `/r/<pub>/c/<comp>/entity/…` page/JSON/compartment links with no index
  lookup; an unplaceable or unresolvable focus renders the honest
  "not in this view" pane plus the released-record link, never a
  fabricated point.
- **Explicit empty compartment selection** — a bare `collection=` is
  `collectionSpecified` ("0 of N compartments"), a real linkable state
  distinct from absent = all; the map toggle canonicalises a full
  selection back to the absent default.
- **Announced focus-clearing** — `clearFocusOutOfScope` drops a selection
  that leaves scope and the caller announces it (`role="status"`), never
  silent.
- **The map viewport stays transient** — no `z`/`lat`/`lon` in the URL (S4
  §8); no localStorage history, accounts or analytics.
- `useWorkspaceState` is the **only** DOM/history adapter — mount parse,
  `push`/`replace`, `popstate` restore. No router, no global store, no
  second source of truth.

### Bounded navigation, stated denominators

- `boundedEgoNetwork` (`web/src/lib/network.ts`) caps the graph at
  **50 nodes / 100 edges** (`EGO_NODE_LIMIT`/`EGO_EDGE_LIMIT`), reports the
  true totals (`"showing X of N"`), and expansion stays one ring at a
  time by node selection — never a national hairball, never silent drops.
- The map's no-JS tabular equivalent is **complete and paginated** (100
  rows/page, prev/next) instead of an unbounded dump; unlocated records
  stay navigable as **bounded per-jurisdiction indicators**
  (`boundedJurisdictionIndicators`, ≤50 ids inline each, true count kept).
- `network.astro` edge lists are bounded with continued-list notes; each
  page names its denominators and the pinned release.
- `ViewSwitch.astro` emits the static `List · Map · Connections` switch
  carrying `?v=1&view=…&release=…`; the islands render the same switch
  with the live state — the two never disagree on the contract.

### Edge evidence (`exports/src/exports/spine_export.py`)

- `NetworkEdge.evidence?: string[]` lists backing claim ids (additive —
  the public-surface schema is permissive); the export stamps them on both
  the materialized-edge and shaped-fallback paths; fixtures carry them.
- The three access kinds stay distinct end-to-end: `configured_access`,
  `observed_use`, `declared_policy` are never merged — each rendered edge
  names its kind, count and claim ids (island detail pane + no-JS
  `<details>` lists).

### Measured per-island budgets (`docs/build/reports/p32.15-island-budgets.md`)

`web/scripts/measure-island-budgets.mjs` walks each island page's emitted
assets over `dist/`; ceilings live in `web/tests/e2e/island-budgets.json`,
are wire-measured (gzip incl. the MapLibre worker) by
`tests/e2e/budget.spec.ts`, and mirrored in `lighthouserc.json`
assertMatrix blocks:

| island | script raw | script gzip | total raw | total gzip |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `/map/` | 1,785,384 B | 496,905 B | 1,913,310 B | 535,117 B |
| `/network/` | 231,309 B | 73,189 B | 285,450 B | 110,040 B |
| `/search/` | 229,763 B | 72,405 B | 268,769 B | 94,121 B |

The zero-JS public pages keep script size 0 / ≤150 KiB; the P31.15
no-basemap/PMTiles contract and per-compartment attribution are unchanged.

## Out of scope honoured

No merge/tag/push-main, no deploy, no basemap, no licence mixing, no
general SPA, no accounts/uploads/collaboration/AI chat, no source-rights
flips, no human labels, no spine writes, no landed-ADR edits.
